request_state.lean: ∀ n ≥ 4, ∀ x y z : ℤ nonzero, IsCoprime x y → IsCoprime x (3z) → IsCoprime y (3z) → x^n + y^n ≠ 3 z^2
request_state.source:
Theorem 1.1       If n ≥ 4 is an integer and

                                  C ∈ {1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 11, 13, 17},

     then the equation
                                            xn + y n = Cz2

     has no solutions in nonzero pairwise coprime integers (x, y, z) with, say, x > y, unless
     (n, C) = (4, 17) or

             (n, C, x, y, z) ∈ {(5, 2, 3, −1, ±11), (5, 11, 3, 2, ±5), (4, 2, 1, −1, ±1)} .
